create_ConstantPruningModifier: create a ConstantPruningModifier to apply constant magnitude-based pruning to specified model parameters
build_parameterized_layers: build parameterized layers from a PyTorch model for a given list of target parameter names
add_mask: add a persistent or hook-based mask to a parameterized layer for weight pruning
update_mask: update a pruning mask by comparing parameter absolute values against an epsilon threshold
apply_masks: apply stored pruning masks to model weights after each optimization step
